layout: specialize
name: alora, rogue companion
mana cost: {3}{U}
types: legendary creature halfling rogue
power toughness: 3/3
activated[1]: specialize {2}
triggered: whenever you attack, up to one target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand.

ALTERNATE

name: alora, cheerful mastermind
mana cost: {3}{W}{U}
types: legendary creature halfling rogue
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: whenever you attack, up to one target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, create a 1/1 white soldier creature token. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, create a 1/1 white soldier creature token.

ALTERNATE

name: alora, cheerful thief
mana cost: {3}{U}{U}
types: legendary creature halfling rogue
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: whenever you attack, up to one target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, a creature of your choice an opponent controls perpetually gets -1/-0. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, a creature of your choice an opponent controls perpetually gets -1/-0.

ALTERNATE

name: alora, cheerful assassin
mana cost: {3}{U}{B}
types: legendary creature halfling rogue assassin
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: whenever you attack, up to one target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, each opponent loses 2 life. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, each opponent loses 2 life.

ALTERNATE

name: alora, cheerful swashbuckler
mana cost: {3}{U}{R}
types: legendary creature halfling rogue
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: whenever you attack, up to one target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, create a treasure token. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, create a treasure token.

ALTERNATE

name: alora, cheerful scout
mana cost: {3}{G}{U}
types: legendary creature halfling rogue scout
power toughness: 4/4
triggered: whenever you attack, up to one target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, it perpetually gets +1/+1. at the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand. if you do, it perpetually gets +1/+1.
